name: Arthur Rackham’s illustrations
description: Rackham’s 1907 colour plates and drawings, curated for this edition by Ink & Quill.
credit: Illustrations by Arthur Rackham (1907), public domain, from Project Gutenberg #28885. Curated by Ink & Quill.

illustrations.alt: Alice stands facing us in a knee-length patterned dress, striped stockings and boots, her hands behind her back.
illustrations.caption: Alice
illustrations.quote: Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank

illustrations.alt: The White Rabbit, in a waistcoat, runs past the dark mouth of a rabbit-hole under a bank of brambles and long grass.
illustrations.quote: when suddenly a White Rabbit with pink eyes ran close by her

illustrations.alt: Alice, grown very tall and thin, stands stiffly with her arms held away from her sides.
illustrations.caption: Curiouser and Curiouser
illustrations.quote: Curiouser and curiouser!” cried Alice

illustrations.alt: Alice swims in the pool of tears among a crowd of creatures: a duck, a dodo, a mouse, a crab and other birds and beasts.
illustrations.caption: The Pool of Tears
illustrations.quote: she was in the pool of tears which she had wept when she was nine feet high

illustrations.alt: The Dodo, a duck and a crowd of birds and small animals press round Alice, all asking who has won.
illustrations.caption: They all crowded round it panting and asking, "But who has won?"
illustrations.quote: they all crowded round it, panting, and asking, “But who has won?”

illustrations.alt: The Mouse sits up on its haunches with its long tail curled, facing Alice, who sits cross-legged on the ground.
illustrations.quote: said Alice, looking down with wonder at the Mouse’s tail

illustrations.alt: Under a tall bare tree the White Rabbit leans forward, calling to Alice, who stands small among the stones.
illustrations.caption: "Why, Mary Ann, what are you doing out here?"
illustrations.quote: Why, Mary Ann, what are you doing out here?

illustrations.alt: Alice stands beside a huge mushroom, looking up at the blue Caterpillar sitting on top of it, smoking a hookah.
illustrations.caption: Advice from a Caterpillar
illustrations.quote: The Caterpillar and Alice looked at each other for some time in silence

illustrations.alt: Alice, shrunk so suddenly that her chin is pressed against her feet, peers out from under her flying hair.
illustrations.quote: She was a good deal frightened by this very sudden change

illustrations.alt: Alice’s head rises above the treetops on her long neck as a pigeon flies at her through the tangled branches.
illustrations.quote: a large pigeon had flown into her face, and was beating her violently with its wings

illustrations.alt: The Frog-Footman sits on the step by a closed door, gazing up at the sky, while Alice stands beside him pointing at the door.
illustrations.quote: How am I to get in?” asked Alice again

illustrations.alt: In the Duchess’s smoky kitchen, plates and a saucepan fly through the air at the Duchess and the baby, while Alice throws up her hands.
illustrations.caption: An unusually large saucepan flew close by it, and very nearly carried it off
illustrations.quote: an unusually large saucepan flew close by it, and very nearly carried it off

illustrations.alt: Alice stands in long grass holding the baby, which has turned into a little pig.
illustrations.caption: It grunted again so violently that she looked down into its face in some alarm
illustrations.quote: It grunted again, so violently, that she looked down into its face in some alarm

illustrations.alt: The Cheshire Cat lies stretched along the branches of a tree, grinning.
illustrations.quote: seeing the Cheshire Cat sitting on a bough of a tree a few yards off

illustrations.alt: Alice stands small at the foot of a gnarled tree, looking up at the Cheshire Cat in its branches.
illustrations.quote: there was the Cat again, sitting on a branch of a tree

illustrations.alt: The Hatter and the March Hare sit at a long table laid with cups and teapots, with Alice in a large armchair at the far end.
illustrations.caption: A Mad Tea-Party
illustrations.quote: There was a table set out under a tree in front of the house, and the March Hare and the Hatter were having tea at it

illustrations.alt: Playing-card gardeners hurriedly paint the white roses of a rose tree red while more cards look on.
illustrations.caption: The Queen turned angrily away from him and said to the Knave, "Turn them over"
illustrations.quote: The Queen turned angrily away from him, and said to the Knave “Turn them over!”

illustrations.alt: Alice tucks a flamingo under her arm, its long neck held straight to use as a croquet mallet.
illustrations.quote: The chief difficulty Alice found at first was in managing her flamingo

illustrations.alt: The Cheshire Cat’s grinning head floats on a little cloud, with no body.
illustrations.quote: she noticed a curious appearance in the air

illustrations.alt: The executioner, a playing card of clubs in a checked hood, leans on a long axe.
illustrations.quote: The executioner’s argument was, that you couldn’t cut off a head

illustrations.alt: The King and Queen of Hearts stand with their court beside a rose tree, the Queen shouting, as a hedgehog crosses the ground.
illustrations.caption: The Queen never left off quarrelling with the other players, and shouting "Off with his head!" or, "Off with her head!"
illustrations.quote: the Queen never left off quarrelling with the other players

illustrations.alt: The Gryphon lies asleep in the sun at the foot of a gnarled tree.
illustrations.quote: They very soon came upon a Gryphon, lying fast asleep in the sun

illustrations.alt: Alice sits on a rock by the sea between the Gryphon and the Mock Turtle.
illustrations.caption: The Mock Turtle drew a long breath and said, "That's very curious"
illustrations.quote: The Mock Turtle drew a long breath, and said “That’s very curious.”

illustrations.alt: The Mock Turtle, with a calf’s head on a turtle’s body, rears up on its hind flippers.
illustrations.quote: cried the Mock Turtle, capering wildly about

illustrations.alt: The court in session: the King and Queen of Hearts on their thrones, the White Rabbit with a trumpet, the jury and the cards below.
illustrations.caption: Who stole the Tarts?
illustrations.quote: The King and Queen of Hearts were seated on their throne when they arrived

illustrations.alt: The Duchess’s cook, a large woman, strides along carrying a pepper-box.
illustrations.quote: The next witness was the Duchess’s cook

illustrations.alt: Alice throws up her arms as the whole pack of cards flies up into the air around her.
illustrations.caption: At this the whole pack rose up into the air, and came flying down upon her
illustrations.quote: At this the whole pack rose up into the air, and came flying down upon her
